result.instructions: Tools for Talexio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are on the monthly payroll this period?"; "List the approved timesheet pay lines for last week in the London unit."; "Who is on approved leave between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-10?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Talexio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run talexio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run talexio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run talexio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. talexio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: talexio_list_organisation_units
tools.title: List organisation units
tools.description: List the active organisation units (departments, sites, companies) of the client. Their ids are the organisationUnitId filter for the other tools. Talexio API: GET /payroll/organisation-units.

tools.name: talexio_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with their payroll fields and the positions that overlap the period. periodFrom and periodTo are yyyy-mm-dd; payrollPeriod is required. Only positions with that pay frequency are returned. Talexio API: GET /payroll/employees.

payrollPeriod.description: Pay frequency: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, FORTNIGHTLY, EVERY_FOUR_WEEKS or NEVER.

countryId.description: Only employees with a position in this country id.

organisationUnitId.description: Only employees in this organisation unit id (see talexio_list_organisation_units).

positionId.description: Only employees who hold this position type id.

jobScheduleId.description: Only employees on this job schedule id.

tools.name: talexio_list_payroll_approvals
tools.title: List approved timesheet pay lines
tools.description: List approved timesheet pay lines per employee, computed the same way as Talexio payslips: hours at day-type rates, overtime, allowances, and penalty rows (negative). Filter by approval date. periodFrom and periodTo are yyyy-mm-dd, at most 92 days apart. Times are in Europe/Malta. Results are grouped per employee; pageSize counts employees. Talexio API: GET /payroll/approvals.

periodFrom.description: Start of the approval date window (yyyy-mm-dd).

periodTo.description: End of the approval date window (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 92 days after periodFrom.

employeeCode.description: Only the employee with this code. An unknown code returns an empty page.

organisationUnitId.description: Only employees of this organisation unit id. Omit for all units.

positionId.description: Only employees who hold this position type id.

jobScheduleId.description: Only employees on this job schedule id.

countryId.description: Only employees with a position in this country id.

payrollPeriod.description: Pay frequency: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, FORTNIGHTLY, EVERY_FOUR_WEEKS or NEVER.

tools.name: talexio_list_time_off
tools.title: List approved time off
tools.description: List approved leave records in a date range, so a planner knows who is away. Only approved leave appears. Cancelled leave is left out unless includeCancelled is true. dateFrom and dateTo are yyyy-mm-dd; the range is at most 366 days. Talexio API: GET /ta/time-off-data.

dateTo.description: End date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 366 days after dateFrom.

unitId.description: Scope to this organisation unit id. Omit to cover every unit you can see.

includeSubUnits.description: Include units beneath unitId. Talexio default: true.

includeCancelled.description: Also return cancelled leave (flagged isCancelled). Default false.

tools.name: talexio_list_shift_templates
tools.title: List shift templates
tools.description: List the shift templates the token user can see, ordered by name. Their ids are used when a roster is planned. The list is limited to the units the user works in. Talexio API: GET /ta/shift-templates.
